players.product: High-capacitance (1uF-100uF) X5R/X6S BME MLCCs (GRM/GCM series) for PDN decoupling

quarterly_data.signal: First-half results, April-September 2025 (semi-annual report): revenue JPY 902,778 million (+2.2% year on year, despite a stronger yen), operating profit JPY 165,136 million (+4.4%), profit attributable to owners of the parent JPY 132,379 million (+1.6%). Components revenue JPY 574,235 million (+9.6%), operating profit JPY 157,663 million (+4.8%); Devices and Modules revenue JPY 329,771 million (-8.0%), operating profit JPY 10,319 million (+7.5%). Capacitors JPY 454,902 million (+9.0%) as MLCCs rose for servers and distributors; inductors / EMI filters JPY 110,746 million (+9.6%); RF and communications JPY 202,681 million (-10.2%); energy and power JPY 74,896 million (-10.5%, lithium-ion batteries down for power tools and game consoles); functional devices JPY 52,188 million (+6.1%). By application, computers JPY 145,863 million (+20.1%) as MLCCs rose for servers. Management states data-center investment continued and demand for AI servers and peripheral equipment expanded. First-half R&D expenses JPY 77,995 million.
quarterly_data.figure: revenue JPY 902,778 million (+2.2%); operating profit JPY 165,136 million (+4.4%); capacitors JPY 454,902 million (+9.0%)

quarterly_data.signal: First-half orders, April-September 2025 (semi-annual report; at selling prices): orders received JPY 918,133 million (+7.2% year on year) and order backlog at September 30, 2025 JPY 302,850 million (+5.3% from March 31, 2025). Capacitors: orders JPY 465,802 million (+11.5%), backlog JPY 152,907 million (+7.7%); inductors / EMI filters: orders JPY 111,433 million (+10.1%), backlog JPY 32,144 million (+2.2%); energy and power backlog JPY 51,853 million (+5.4%). First-half production JPY 900,312 million (+3.1%).
